invitation_pending_unique.name: invitation_pending_unique
invitation_pending_unique.where: accepted_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL

invitation_client_scope_check.name: invitation_client_scope_check
invitation_client_scope_check.value: client_scope IS NULL OR (role = 'account_manager' AND jsonb_typeof(client_scope) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(client_scope) > 0)

membership_client_scope_check.name: membership_client_scope_check
membership_client_scope_check.value: client_scope IS NULL OR (role = 'account_manager' AND jsonb_typeof(client_scope) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(client_scope) > 0)

brief_item_subject_check.name: brief_item_subject_check
brief_item_subject_check.value: subject = 'self' OR competitor_id IS NOT NULL

recommendation_move_unique.name: recommendation_move_unique
recommendation_move_unique.where: source = 'move' AND move_id IS NOT NULL

alert_delivery_check.name: alert_delivery_check
alert_delivery_check.value: delivery IS NULL OR delivery IN ('immediate', 'digest')

alert_written_check.name: alert_written_check
alert_written_check.value: written IS NULL OR written IN ('model', 'template')

detected_change_subject_check.name: detected_change_subject_check
detected_change_subject_check.value: (after_capture_id IS NOT NULL) <> (rank_scan_id IS NOT NULL)

kb_article_scope_check.name: kb_article_scope_check
kb_article_scope_check.value:
(level = 'platform' AND agency_id IS NULL AND client_id IS NULL)
        OR (level = 'agency' AND agency_id IS NOT NULL AND client_id IS NULL)
        OR (level = 'client' AND agency_id IS NOT NULL AND client_id IS NOT NULL)

client_score_thresholds_check.name: client_score_thresholds_check
client_score_thresholds_check.value:
score_thresholds IS NULL OR (
        (score_thresholds ? 'alert') AND (score_thresholds ? 'brief')
        AND jsonb_typeof(score_thresholds->'alert') = 'number' AND jsonb_typeof(score_thresholds->'brief') = 'number'
        AND (score_thresholds->>'brief')::numeric >= 0 AND (score_thresholds->>'alert')::numeric <= 100
        AND (score_thresholds->>'brief')::numeric < (score_thresholds->>'alert')::numeric)
